notes.title: RELEASE DATE AND NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! Exciting news – A Tale of Paper: Refolded will be launching on Steam (and other PC storefronts + Xbox) on 19th August. If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and you'll receive a reminder on launch day as soon as it's available.[/b]

To celebrate the release date announcement, we've put together a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=SYMcrQpGT-c;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for the support and we can't wait for you to experience A Tale of Paper: Refolded when it launches in just a few weeks!
